name: Escape the Pyramid – Fire & Ice

features.name: Fire and ice marks
features.description: Random positions are marked every spin.

features.name: Fire wilds / ice respins
features.description: Fire scatters make wilds; ice scatters transform symbols and respin.

features.name: Ice and Fire feature
features.description: Both scatters together turn all marks wild with respins.

review:
A smart, original design: every spin marks random spots with fire or ice. A fire scatter on reel one turns the fire spots wild; an ice scatter on reel six turns ice spots into a random symbol and starts three respins, where Upgrade improves that symbol and +1 adds a respin.

Land both scatters at once for Ice and Fire: every marked spot turns wild and three respins begin with only blanks, sticky wilds and +1s. Up to 5,000x, 96.5% RTP.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Provider doesn't publish a volatility rating
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
